decisions.reason: Changing the visual reference sites does not alter the requirement that the site be mobile-friendly.
The requested resemblance to new reference sites does not change the established logo, brand name, colors, or cross-location brand identity.
The visual-reference change does not alter the requirement for dedicated location pages, the current location list, or cross-location consistency.
The source changes design references but does not change the reusable-template strategy, Seattle template basis, or no-redesign requirement for future locations.
Visual reference sites do not affect the Wix booking platform, booking host, or Seattle booking activation rules.
The source does not change location-selector options, routing behavior, or routing destinations.
The master site's national role and separation of booking handling remain valid regardless of the selected visual references.
The source does not mention or change location packages or pricing policies.
Changing visual reference sites does not affect the architecture requiring separate Wix websites and accounts for locations.
The visual-design reference change does not alter isolation of bookings, business data, reporting, access, or other location operations.
The request to resemble different websites changes visual references but does not necessarily change the specified homepage sections or offering visibility.
The source does not change Seattle's coming-soon mode, required sections, button label, or opening transition behavior.
